caseName: Florida ex rel. Hardware Mutual Casualty Co. v. Knott
caseNameFull: Florida ex rel. Hardware Mutual Casualty Co. v. Knott, State Treasurer & Insurance Commissioner
attorneys: Mr. Dean Acheson for appellants. No appearance for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

It appearing that the cause has become moot, the motion to vacate and remand is granted and the judgment of the Supreme Court of Florida is vacated and the cause is remanded for such further proceedings as by that court may be deemed appropriate.
